reviews.text:
Hello Svetlana,

Thank you for your positive review. We are happy that we were able to meet your expectations.

Kind regards,
Bokhove and Bouman Veterinary Clinic Amsterdam

Very satisfied with this veterinarian! The veterinarians are incredibly friendly and really take their time with you. In addition, everything looks very neat, well-cared-for, and especially very clean. That immediately gives a pleasant and trustworthy feeling. Definitely recommended!
Very nice staff, both at the reception desk and at the vet. They listen very well to you as the owner and examine your pet very thoroughly. Everything also looks nice and clean.

We have visited Bokhove & Bouman Veterinary Clinic several times now with our sweet Dushi, including for pancreatitis and recently after a nasty fall.

Every time, we received incredibly skilled and professional help. After her recent fall last week, Dushi was thoroughly examined and expert X-rays were taken. Everything was explained calmly and clearly.

What also particularly touches us is the genuine involvement, understanding, and the loving way in which Dushi is treated. She is not seen merely as a patient, but as our precious little family member. You can feel that the people working here truly have a heart for animals and understand how much an animal means to its owner.

We are very grateful for all the good, warm care. Absolutely five stars from us ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ and a loving paw print from Dushi 🐾❤️

Dear Pavel,

Thank you for your appreciation! We are happy that you had a positive experience with us.

Kind regards,

Bokhove and Bouman Veterinary Clinic Amsterdam

My cat had to remove a tooth and I was extremely anxious, as he had never had any surgery. The staff at the clinic were SO nice and caring, they ran several exams to ensure the anesthesia would go well and then took great care of him as he recovered. I am super grateful for their professionalism and care! Really recommend this vet clinic.

good people for taking money  from you
they are very expensive and didn't help at all
and they lead you ways to continue paying to them
People who work there are committed and are good to animals.
Thank you for the 5 stars
Thanks for the 5 stars!

Due to a referral for our cat Henk, we visited this clinic for the first time today. Because Henk had to be anesthetized and this was our first visit, it was a bit nerve-wracking.
However, that turned out to be completely unnecessary. What an incredibly kind and skilled team is ready here to provide the best care for your pet.
Our little Henkie is quite timid, and they were very understanding about that. The team truly puts the animal first; you notice this in the welcome, the intake, and the telephone consultations during the treatment.
We immediately decided that we wanted to register our Henkie as a patient here, and that was possible.
Not that our other vet is bad, but there is just a little more attention, care, and calmness radiating here, which makes us feel immediately at ease.
Thank you!
The most efficient handling of my crazy jack russell terrier
This church touched my heart. Every Sunday, I am here to pray for my family and friends as well as my lovely neighbors.

Been living in Amsterdam for 3 years and have visited multiple vets but this was by far my favourite. The attention and kindness from the the receptionist to the vets and assistants was the best service I have received and will be making them my permanent clinic.
Top veterinarians, great help, and super people!
Thank you

Great clinic. They helped me immediately when my cat needed dental surgery. Very pleasant communication regarding the schedule, costs, and contact before, during, and after the operation. The aftercare was also adequate and caring. My cat Guusje is in very good hands with these skilled people. I especially enjoyed the contact with Charlotte! They are amazing! Thank you so much.
Thank you

Received good help, clearly explained.
Friendly staff.

Yesterday I was helped very well by the vet and assistant. Ginger was immediately registered for his microchip after placement. I've left there now. It became way too expensive and was taken over by such a large chain. Plus, a small heart murmur was not detected during the vaccination. But the vet who neutered him did. I've been gone from there for a year and a half now. During Ginger's check-up and vaccination, something was not detected, namely a small heart murmur. That was noticed by another vet because he was going under the knife for neutering.

Recently acquired by Evidensia b.v. This is a foreign organization (cartel)

that is buying up many veterinary practices in the Netherlands.

Resulting in absurdly high prices/costs...

And now it also appears to be using uncertified veterinary assistants.

Yesterday I went to the vet because my dog ​​was having hip problems.
He was examined by an English-speaking doctor (no problem), and after a brief examination, she told me she heard a murmur near his heart and also asked if he was drinking a lot, which he was, but not much more than normal.
Recommended... get a heart ultrasound (around €300) and blood tests for kidneys and diabetes (€200 each).
Metacam plus consultation €150.
Prescribed Metacam for the hip.
When I got home, I read in the package insert that you shouldn't give Metacam to people with heart or kidney problems, so I called the practice.
She said I'd check with the doctor... I'll call you back shortly.
I'm still waiting for the call (two days now).
I only came for a consultation because you can't buy Metacam without a prescription, and it felt like they were trying to find all sorts of things just to rip you off. I'll just call again tomorrow about the Metacam package insert.

Had to help my 17-year-old dog Lilly over the rainbow, let her fall asleep in a familiar (home) environment, thank you for the condolence card, received so much help over the past years from Team Bokhove & Bouman! Thank you XXX

Not satisfied. A completely wrong diagnosis was made for my mother's dog, and because it eventually turned out (after consulting another veterinary clinic, where an ultrasound was performed) that the dog was terminally ill and in extreme pain, he had to be put to sleep quickly. Given my mother's health circumstances, it had to be done at home. There really was no other option. They could only come by after a week. They did not want to come to the house. No compassion, insight, or empathy whatsoever.
Always helpful and kind to animals (and people, of course)
Thank you for the 5 stars
Thank you for the 5 stars.
Clean clinic and helped on time.

Since we moved to Amsterdam 14y ago this clinic has been responsible for our pets.
The professionalism from the front desk to the doctors is upstanding.
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND 🌹🌹🌹🌹🌹 …

This is one of those clinics that has been taken over by a large commercial company. Prescribing lots of antibiotics, lots of testing, and no aftercare. Diagnosed our dog with a potentially life-threatening disease, gave her antibiotics, and no aftercare before the weekend—no phone call or update before the weekend. We had asked days in advance if she could be admitted, but they were too busy, too heavy, no motivation; on Monday she was dead.

Poor communication, bad diagnosis; we didn't know what to do if things went badly. Eventually, we spent a whole night on the phone with another hospital trying to keep the dog cool, but the next morning she was dead, 30 minutes after she arrived at the hospital, alone and completely broken.

We suffered from the pain and the bad experience with these doctors for years.

This was two years ago, but only now can I write about it. Not every animal can be saved, but we and our dog truly suffered here. Subsequently, I couldn't manage to squeeze out anything more than a hesitant little apology. A lack of empathy and being terrified to acknowledge a mistake or admit even the slightest thing—then you are not a healthcare professional, but a puppet of commercial interests.
The staff is approachable and you receive excellent guidance throughout. Keep up the good work.

About a year ago, my dog ​​was unfortunately seen by several veterinarians in the practice for the same complaint. Long story short, no solutions or further investigation from the vets. I decided to switch to a different vet (thank goodness). To top it all off, they send me the written file, which the dogs refuse to read. That vet has since left, but I wanted to personally thank him for his incompetence and the fact that my friend is now missing a toe!
Super nice veterinary clinic! I am always helped very kindly. I recommend this veterinary clinic to everyone and it is very reliable.
Since Mr. J. Bouman is no longer working in the building, we find it has become much worse (and more expensive).
